title: Shrinking an elementary etale neighbourhood to make the fibre a singleton

standard_prerequisites.name: Elementary neighbourhoods are filtered
standard_prerequisites.use: The category of elementary etale neighbourhoods of (X, x) is filtered.

standard_prerequisites.name: Generic points of quasi-finite fibres
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the generic point xi of the fibre.

core_obligations: Start with any elementary etale neighbourhood (U, u) -> (X, x).
Take the generic point xi of the irreducible fibre over x and shrink U to an open neighbourhood of xi where the fibre is a singleton.
The shrunk (U', u') is again an elementary etale neighbourhood and maps into the original one.
Conclude: such singleton-fibre neighbourhoods are cofinal.
proof_roadmap: Start from a neighbourhood; generic point and shrink; cofinality.
difficulty_reason: A cofinality argument; the shrink step is a standard quasi-finite generic-point move.
